      "login": "purpleKarrot",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objects to util::Result error handling over runtime performance and C++ idiom concerns"
    },
    {
      "login": "optout21",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out inconsistency with ignored FlushStateToDisk return values mutating state"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:1693183422",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Call sites may easily forget to unwrap the inner result and miss interruption",
      "quote": "Seems fragile to use `util::Result<InterruptResult>`. Wrapping one result into another is fragile, because call-sites may easily forget to unwrap the inner result",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that replacing with Result<void, InterruptResult> would be fine and safer, though not yet changed",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:1707623223"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:1707623223",
      "status_by_quote": "It sounds like you want `Result<InterruptResult, void>` to be replaced with `Result<void, InterruptResult>` which would be ok with me."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4171045172",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Result-style error handling undermines runtime performance and runs contrary to C++ idioms",
      "quote": "I see Result-style error handling as a rustism that should be kept out of the C++ codebase of Bitcoin core.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3446525045",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Ignoring the return value from FlushStateToDisk while allowing it to mutate validation state creates inconsistencies",
      "quote": "the return value from `FlushStateToDisk` is ignored, but it can cause change in `state` -- unclear if this was intended or just an unintended side effect.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author clarified the comment in a push and reviewer accepted splitting the issue into #35621",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3488550312"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3494907286",
      "status_by_quote": "Addressing this single case has been split off into #35621 ."
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "respond to purpleKarrot's approach objection to util::Result",
      "id": "c:4171045172"
    }

Graysonbarton's approval is excluded from support as an account with no history and no substantive rationale."
}
